SOLUTIONS.TITLE: Custom Software Engineering
SOLUTIONS.SUBTITLE: We develop the software your company needs to differentiate itself. Robust, secure, and scalable solutions.
SOLUTIONS.WEB_DESC: Mission-Critical Application Engineering. Development of distributed systems, microservices, and high-concurrency web platforms designed to scale globally.
SOLUTIONS.WEB_DETAIL_CONTENT:
Our approach to Application Engineering transcends traditional web development. We create complex digital ecosystems.

Core Capabilities

  • Microservices and Micro-frontend Architectures.
  • Multi-tenant SaaS Platforms.
  • High Concurrency and Low Latency Systems.
  • Enterprise Integration (ESB, Kafka, RabbitMQ).

We implement Angular with SSR for optimal performance and Node.js/Go/Java backends optimized for the cloud.
SOLUTIONS.MOBILE_DESC: Native and cross-platform mobile solutions integrated with core corporate systems.
SOLUTIONS.MOBILE_DETAIL_CONTENT: Development of secure mobile applications for iOS and Android that extend your business capabilities to the edge. Offline-first synchronization, biometric security, and Mobile Device Management (MDM) for corporate environments.
SOLUTIONS.DESKTOP_DESC: Desktop software for critical operations, industrial control, and service points.
SOLUTIONS.DESKTOP_DETAIL_CONTENT: Robust desktop applications using Electron and .NET MAUI. Optimized for environments where the web doesn't reach: direct hardware control, intensive local processing, and mission-critical operations on the plant floor or in-store.
SOLUTIONS.CLOUD_DESC: Infrastructure modernization, cloud migration, and container orchestration (Kubernetes).
SOLUTIONS.CLOUD_DETAIL_CONTENT: Cloud-Agnostic or Native (AWS/Azure) Architecture. We implement Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), advanced CI/CD pipelines, and Disaster Recovery (DR) strategies to ensure business continuity.

PRODUCTS.TITLE: Proprietary Platforms
PRODUCTS.SUBTITLE: Market-proven SaaS solutions, available for immediate implementation or as a base for custom products (White Label).
PRODUCTS.ERP_DESC: Modular and extensible ERP platform. Total orchestration of business resources with integrated business intelligence.
PRODUCTS.ERP_DETAIL_CONTENT:
JSL-ERP is more than a management system; it is the central nervous system of your company. Event-driven architecture for real-time reactivity.

Enterprise Modules

  • Multi-currency and Multi-entity Financial Management.
  • Intelligent Supply Chain (AI-driven forecasting).
  • Global HRMS with local compliance.

Available as SaaS or On-Premise implementation.
PRODUCTS.POS_DESC: Unified Commerce Ecosystem (POS & Cloud). An API-first omnichannel platform designed for retail chains requiring real-time synchronization and distributed architecture.
PRODUCTS.POS_DETAIL_CONTENT:
Transform the in-store experience with Unified Commerce POS. Designed for retail chains with hundreds of locations.

Key Features

  • Resilient Offline-First Architecture.
  • API-First for integration with E-commerce and third-party Apps.
  • Centralized inventory and price management in real-time.
PRODUCTS.MOBILE_APPS_DESC: Satellite application suite for JSL-ERP and POS, extending functionality to the mobile workforce.
PRODUCTS.MOBILE_APPS_DETAIL_CONTENT: Empower your workforce with dedicated mobile tools. Apps for last-mile logistics, warehouse management (WMS handhelds), and real-time executive dashboards.
PRODUCTS.INTEGRATION_DESC: Use our tech core and let us build custom modules on top. Accelerate your Time-to-Market leveraging our proven base.

PROJECTS.TITLE: Innovation Portfolio
PROJECTS.SUBTITLE: Auditable results. See how our engineering solutions generate ROI and competitive advantages.
PROJECTS.CASE_ERP_DESC: Supply chain process reengineering achieving 30% OPEX reduction through custom ERP implementation.
PROJECTS.CASE_ERP_DETAIL_CHALLENGE: The client operated with disconnected legacy systems, resulting in data silos and latency in critical inventory decision-making.
PROJECTS.CASE_ERP_DETAIL_SOLUTION: Implementation of Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) with JSL-ERP as the core. Zero-downtime data migration and deployment of mobile interfaces for operators.
PROJECTS.CASE_ERP_DETAIL_RESULT: 30% reduction in operating costs. Real-time inventory visibility (99.9% accuracy). Positive ROI achieved in 8 months.
PROJECTS.CASE_ECOMMERCE_DESC: Composable commerce architecture for industrial distributor, handling 50k+ SKUs and complex dynamic pricing.
PROJECTS.CASE_ECOMMERCE_DETAIL_CHALLENGE: The previous monolithic platform could not scale to handle traffic spikes nor support complex contractual pricing logic per client.
PROJECTS.CASE_ECOMMERCE_DETAIL_SOLUTION: Development of Headless Commerce solution with Angular Frontend and Microservices Backend. Elasticsearch search engine and Redis distributed cache.
PROJECTS.CASE_ECOMMERCE_DETAIL_RESULT: 45% increase in digital B2B sales. Sub-second page load time. Ability to handle 10x previous peak traffic.
PROJECTS.CASE_MOBILE_APP_DESC: IoT and mobile system for real-time transport asset monitoring, improving route efficiency by 40%.
PROJECTS.CASE_MOBILE_APP_DETAIL_CHALLENGE: Lack of last-mile visibility and high fuel costs due to inefficient routes and unscheduled maintenance.
PROJECTS.CASE_MOBILE_APP_DETAIL_SOLUTION: Mobile IoT solution with real-time geolocation and predictive analytics. Native apps for drivers and web control tower for dispatchers.
PROJECTS.CASE_MOBILE_APP_DETAIL_RESULT: Route optimization reduced fuel consumption by 18%. 40% improvement in delivery times and SLA compliance.
PROJECTS.CTA_SUBTITLE: Our consultants can audit your current infrastructure and propose a modernization plan.
